resources.string: Direct Camera2 photo/H.264 video capture and capability inspector

Direct photo and owner-controlled H.264 video capture without audio are implemented in source; Android runtime and physical-device validation are still required. If a direct encoder surface is unavailable, Video uses Android’s visible capture hand-off.
